by
  intro h
  have h1 := h 1
  cases' h1 with c hc
  have hc1 := hc 0
  cases' hc1 with m hm
  have hm1 : (1 : ℕ) < m := by simpa using hm
  have h0 : (0 : ℤ) ∈ c.covers 0 := by
    rcases hm with ⟨hmL, hmR⟩
    have hdiv : (m : ℤ) ∣ (0 : ℤ) := by
      have hpos : (0 : ℤ) ∈ ((m : ℤ) • Ideal.span {(m : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) := by
        simpa [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] using hmR
      simpa [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] using hpos
    exact hdiv
  rcases hm with ⟨hmL, hmR⟩
  have hcover : c.covers 0 = ⋃ m : ℕ, (m : ℤ) • Ideal.span {(m : ℤ)} := by
    exact (c.covers 0)
  have hcontradiction : ¬ (∀ m : ℕ, (0 : ℤ) ∈ (m : ℤ) • Ideal.span {(m : ℤ)} → False) := by
    intro hH
    have hH0 : ¬ (0 : ℤ) ∈ (0 : ℤ) • Ideal.span {(0 : ℤ)} := by
      intro h0
      exact hH 0 h0
    have h0in : (0 : ℤ) ∈ (0 : ℤ) • Ideal.span {(0 : ℤ)} := by
      simpa [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    exact hH0 h0in
  exact hcontradiction fun _ => by
    intro h
    exact False.elim (by
      rcases hm with ⟨hmL, hmR⟩
      have hpos : (0 : ℤ) ∈ ((m : ℤ) • Ideal.span {(m : ℤ)} : Ideal ℤ) := by
        simpa [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] using hmR
      have hdiv : (m : ℤ) ∣ (0 : ℤ) := by
        simpa [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] using hpos
      exact False.elim (by
